authorization.purpose: P0-P7 physical digital-twin diagnostics and frozen four-ROI inference

diagnostic_continuation_policy.p2_partial_continuation: P3/P5 may complete only as maximum-grid diagnostics when engineering preflight is valid; all reports must preserve sampling limitations and candidate ranking is not accepted

data.population_note: C0 validation population has been reused by C3.4-C3.8 and is not independent

dmd.mnist_patch: centered 28x28 micromirrors in native array; surrounding mirrors OFF
dmd.gray_mode: effective_scalar_amplitude sqrt(gray/255); diagnostic representation, not measured bit-plane timing
dmd.on_state: unit-amplitude specular ON port assumed coupled to relay
dmd.off_state: zero field in collected port assumed
dmd.tilt_treatment: nominal 12 degree tilt recorded; actual facet azimuth, illumination and selected diffraction order are unknown, so no fabricated blaze efficiency or orientation phase ramp is applied

model_levels.level_0: binary scalar pixel amplitude; no micromirror gaps resolved
model_levels.level_1: coherent sampled square-micromirror apertures using native pitch and fill factor; ON specular axis aligned to relay by assumption; 3D blaze/order coupling remains unmodeled and UNKNOWN

composition.DMD_to_L2: 70 mm DMD/temporary-mirror branch + 100 mm BS-to-fold-mirror + 60 mm fold-mirror-to-L2

input_relay.dmd_insertion_and_folded_on_axis: ASSUMED_DIAGNOSTIC; ACTUAL DMD PORT GEOMETRY UNKNOWN

phase_layer.transmission_model: unit-amplitude exp(i*wrapped_phase); physical complex transmission UNKNOWN
phase_layer.candidate_arrays: use original saved phase maps without edits or reorientation

output_relay.lens_spec_status: BOM_NOMINAL; installed count, serial, principal planes and clear aperture UNKNOWN

PHOTO_ESTIMATE_AND_C37_C38_REFERENCE.magnification: not a conjugate image under the thin-lens model; B nonzero

cmos.sensor_source: USER_SPEC_IMAGE_GSENSE2020; model family matches Dhyana 401D specification but camera-unit identity UNKNOWN
cmos.readout_mode_exposure_gain_dark_flat_qe5: UNKNOWN; ideal linear detector model only
cmos.pixel_response_model: subpixel irradiance samples are area-averaged to integrate each physical pixel; exact area-overlap allocation for fixed ROIs; dark, noise, gain, QE and saturation are not modeled
cmos.registration: ASSUMED_DIAGNOSTIC; physical ROI window centered on sensor

pixel_to_window_affine.status: ASSUMED_DIAGNOSTIC; replace with measured CMOS origin, rotation, x/y flips, scale and subpixel offset
pixel_to_window_affine.coordinate_order: pixel edge [column, row] to physical window [x, y], y down

fixed_roi_geometry.coordinate_origin: top-left of centered CMOS physical window
fixed_roi_geometry.decision: fixed four physical ROI energy integrals followed by argmax; zero-energy and tied maxima abstain

numerics.propagation_model: paraxial scalar Fresnel using separable Bluestein-CZT on the named planes
numerics.centering: sample-centered grids; even sensor uses edge coordinate at index 1024 as optical center
